build: cargo build --release -p thessa-terrain-native; default release profile and hud feature

ownership.mit: render-core::mesh static source descriptors and checked rigid instances; render-assets embedded static GLB decoder; render-wgpu persistent opaque instanced draw
ownership.gpl: existing pilot visual basis/asset calibration extracted unchanged into flight-authority::presentation; native initial-flight snapshot and host conversion stay game-owned
ownership.asset: North American X-15 Plane by cmoreau, CC BY 4.0; assets/models/north_american_x-15_plane.LICENSE.txt includes attribution/source/license links

source.calibration_boundary: 15.45/16.77 scale retained for old-pilot compatibility; actual visual X extent is about 16.393m, not a corrected physical calibration
source.subset: embedded PNG/JPEG, dense POSITION/NORMAL/TEXCOORD_0, flattened static triangles, opaque non-emissive materials; no external URIs, skins, animations, sparse accessors or extensions
source.bevy_bridge: sRGB base-color and linear normal/ORM/AO; shared ORM/AO image handle; generated tangents; unity normal/AO strengths required
source.native_material: base color/Lambert only; normal/ORM/AO CPU sources retained but not uploaded/used; one source mip

stationary_offscreen.boundary: host presentation/streaming/camera/classify/raster/HUD/upload/GPU-completion latency; excludes setup, pre-stream, warm-up and capture readback
stationary_offscreen.conclusion: overlapping medians; asynchronous material work and unlocked clocks do not isolate an adapter tax or establish a speedup

mesh_microbenchmark.boundary: normalized single-mip zero-lit synthetic source: host frame/instance upload, clear, indexed instanced raster, submit and device completion; zero-instance floor still uploads frame uniforms

native_preview.state: existing FlightAuthority::new north-pole constructor snapshot at SimTime::EPOCH, before old-client PostStartup COAST relocation; no live integration/interpolation/controller
native_preview.boundary: different terrain cover/camera from stationary terrain A/B; do not subtract these times to infer isolated mesh cost; dark polar ground/reverse view has no manufactured ambient or sky

native_wayland_smoke.boundary: host presentation requests including compositor policy, not display feedback, GPU-only time or game FPS

legacy_bevy_smoke.limitations: embedded server absent: existing local simulation fallback; ALSA/JACK diagnostics; not an audio/network test, equal-scene performance comparison or visual parity proof

verification.gpu_regressions: exact textured pixels, color/depth loads, translation/rotation/rebase invariance, multi/empty instances and atomic rejection of invalid camera/light/instance/capacity publications; actual model over terrain
verification.camera_regression: exact-pole initial flight required a finite tangent; close camera and normalized compatibility quaternion validated
verification.review: local source ownership/API/license, accessor bounds/types/budgets, color-space, pose publication, target lifetime and shared-device review; no GPL-to-MIT transfer

captures.meaning: initial flight-state mesh preview; not live flight or PBR parity
same frozen vehicle, orbit camera swept to 3.774rad; dark reverse view, no ambient model
legacy paused COAST pilot consumes shared source; different camera/scene, not visual parity

limitations: Static embedded GLB subset and synchronous old-pilot startup conversion, not a generic runtime asset registry, streaming or hot-reload system.
Native source remains resident at 96MiB CPU RGBA; source retirement and mip generation are not optimized yet.
No live moving-object state/interpolation/network integration, flight camera/controller/UI migration, material parity, shadows, atmosphere or final visual acceptance.
No culling/LOD, indirect heterogeneous scene submission, device-loss recovery or acceleration-structure implementation is established by this slice.
